units.translation: ⟦1⟧ 'love'; ⟦2⟧ already at 885; on ⟦3⟧ (the friendly face) Il. Wecklein compares ⟦4⟧ Dd. ⟦5⟧. The present ⟦6⟧ I do not understand here, since the speech is about the persuasion that has taken place, which finally succeeded (aor. ⟦7⟧); therefore ⟦8⟧ imperfect.
terrible is the face of Persuasion

⟦1⟧, worshipped in Athens (CIA I, 23; Aristoph. ⟦2⟧. 410; Hesych. under ⟦3⟧), Sparta, Thebes, Olympia, etc. (Preller-Robert Myth. 150), guides the assemblies of the citizens and the speaking and persuading in them: ⟦4⟧ is said to ⟦5⟧. 500 to the sausage-seller going into the council. ⟦6⟧ is explained by 1012 ⟦7⟧, and this again (Wieseler) by ⟦8⟧ (imitation of A.) ⟦9⟧ (namely ⟦10⟧); therefore ⟦11⟧ is neuter. Our strife, always directed toward the good, prevails as now constantly. In ⟦12⟧ Athena probably includes herself with Zeus. Chorus antistr. ⟦13⟧, 976-987. No civil war; concord of the citizens. Cf. in the blessing song of the Suppliants 661: ⟦14⟧ ⟨⟦15⟧⟩ ⟦16⟧. With 980 compare also ⟦17⟧ ⟦18⟧. ⟦19⟧ is Homeric. ⟦20⟧ still ⟦21⟧ ⟦22⟧, ⟦23⟧; Hesych. explains with ⟦24⟧. If the rhythm of 981 is correctly determined as dactylic, then ⟦25⟧ must be changed, most simply to ⟦26⟧ (⟦27⟧) and then ⟦28⟧ ⟨⟦29⟧’⟩ ⟦30⟧, cf. ⟦31⟧ 464. ⟦32⟧ yet to ⟦33⟧.
and may Zeus of the Assembly protect you
may there be good intent for good things among the citizens
and to the city grant good thoughts for great goods
to stain the ground of the land with bloodshed
and the dust of the earth may drink the black-clotted blood of murder
do not, I pray, learn of men dying or wounded
983 ⟦1⟧ stands in contrast to the preceding; ⟦2⟧ contains a further object parallel to ⟦3⟧.
may they give joys in return

Exhortation to the citizens to honor these deities now also accordingly. The slightly corrupted beginning must be emended so that the Erinyes are not addressed (which happens only in the next, in content entirely different system); therefore ⟦1⟧(⟦2⟧) (M f) . .
⟦1⟧: are they not intent on finding the way to blessings? So Homer ⟦2⟧ . . ⟦3⟧ Ρ 286; ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧, and A. himself ⟦6⟧ ⟦7⟧. —
they did not intend to throw
think, as one fearing, not to neglect the gods
V. 990 ⟦1⟧ refers to the, naturally retained, terrifying mask = face.
